summary: Lyell Immunopharma filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a press release that its LYL273 GCC-targeted CAR T-cell program completed technology transfer to the LyFE Manufacturing Center in Bothell, Washington, following FDA review of an improved manufacturing process and updated analytical methods. The Phase 1/2 trial in third- or later-line relapsed/refractory metastatic colorectal cancer continues dosing to determine the recommended Phase 2 dose, with additional data and an End-of-Phase 1 FDA meeting expected in 2027. This is a routine clinical and manufacturing operations update, not a special situation; no deal terms are stated.
